title: batrachium × segretii
intro: Batrachium × segretii, commonly known as Segre's Marsh Cress, is a hybrid aquatic plant that belongs to the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestive health.
